about: A score pass 2 (AP2): what A18 THE CROSSING's delivered picture measures, for barmap_ap2.py. Frames are A cut frames. Every frame here was projected through the delivered candidate's own camera (music/src/measure_ap2_crossing.py); the set-off was also checked on the delivered frames 5100-5260, which reproduce the projected lantern path and show the terrain sliding as the set-off predicts but do not resolve its frame alone; the watch-fire passes are projection only. Full record and evidence images in the file named by measured_by.output; the depths quoted for the watch-fires in claude-owner-night/codex/ascore_claude_projection_probe.json (projection only).
